text:
maya li: Heads-up: Acme pilot slipped 2 weeks. Need a quick decision on scope — push launch or cut features? status + ask for quick sync.
ravi patel: What exactly slipped? infra or onboarding?
maya li: Dependency: SSO cert and their infra team delayed SAML cert rollout. Only affects tenant onboarding and admin SSO.
jon ko: We can split: ship MVP-core (chat + embeddings + basic user mgmt) and deprioritize multi-tenant dashboards, reporting, role mappings to v1. That would keep SLA for pilot. Thoughts?
emily chu: Need to ensure onboarding flow still coherent. If we cut role mappings, update copy + warning UI.
ravi patel: We can scope a 'lite onboarding' flow in ~3 dev days, move advanced mapping to v1. But telemetry + rollout automation is risky.
maya li: :chart_with_upwards_trend: Customer said they're ok with pilot if core inference is stable. Reporting is less critical.
jon ko: Proposal: Freeze features for launch (MVP): chat, embedding, tenant OIDC, per-tenant quotas. Defer: tenant analytics, custom roles, CSV export. Timeline: keep launch date; canary to 10% then full. If agree, I'll update roadmap + canary runbook.
ravi patel: Clarify 'tenant OIDC' — do we mean OIDC first? SAML still blocked.
maya li: Yes OIDC first. SAML moved to v1. We'll ship a migration doc.
emily chu: I'll draft microcopy and a checklist for lite onboarding. ETA EOD.
jon ko: MVP-lite checklist:
```
- [ ] Enable OIDC
- [ ] Quota enforcement
- [ ] Canary runbook
- [ ] Customer comms email
```
jon ko: /assign owners — I'll own rollout, @ravi patel infra, @emily chu UI, @maya li customer comms.
deploy-bot: canary pipeline queued for feature/tenant-lite at 08:00 UTC.
ravi patel: Need to update console guardrails for quota enforcement. Punting analytics helps DB load.
maya li: Decision: ship MVP-lite and keep launch date. Action items: update roadmap doc, eng to scope OIDC + quotas, design to update flows, comms to customer. I'll send the email. :thumbsup: 
jon ko: I'll open a roadmap PR and tag scope-cut on affected tickets.
emily chu: Leaving notes on Figma with blurred analytics screens and 'coming in v1' tooltip copy.
maya li: Thanks all — post blockers here. Setting a follow-up sync 24h before launch.
